project_intent: Extract a controllable designer-lettering creation method that transfers to new characters with superior actual aesthetic quality, not redraw individual glyphs.

context_from_prior.observed_common_failure: Authentic role-sensitive pen/brush gesture and ink topology unavailable; angle or static-width transfer on printed-font skeletons produced no human-approved quality gain.

published_approach.title: InkDiffuser: High-Fidelity One-shot Chinese Calligraphy via Differentiable Morphological Optimization
directly_observed_operations: DIS loss turns RGB/gray into ink-map representation
soft erosion preserves/compares central ink mass
soft dilation and eroded masks form inside/outside ink boundary band
gradient and Laplacian compare edge sharpness/curvature in the boundary band
high-frequency features/learnable fusion aim to preserve fine contour information rather than only typography overall structure
published_approach.important_limit: These are source- and target-conditioned training losses; without a same-character styled training target and trained weights they do not generate new calligraphy independently. A static source is not real hand motion.

executable_release_audit.do_not_label: model deployed, pretrained assets accessible, design capability validated or creator-brush-movements reconstructed

DCOH120K.contains: Tablet position, stroke index, timestamp, tilt and pressure, but not automatically outstanding brush-art lettering
DCOH120K.access: Academic application + approval required; noncommercial only; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; not retrieved nor trainable without approval

HCSU.useful: author/style-conditioned labeled historical calligraphy and fine-grained ink/stroke/structure annotations
HCSU.limitation: CC BY-NC 4.0 images/data; analysis annotations are not real recorded creator motions

BCSS.limitation: source examples do not imply one author style family; research rights, commercial permissions unresolved

next_real_work.first_gate: Choose an attributable multi-glyph professionally designed family with permitted usage, ideally 3+ examples from same artist. Document exact author, content diversity, rights and useful per-role source evidence before generation.
next_real_work.method_candidate: Separate glyph identity/topology, stroke-role-specific gesture, ink core, boundary bands, and edge texture. Only train/test source-backed structural priors rather than arbitrary global pixel noise.
next_real_work.contrast: Same unseen character and identical compute budget: R2 nearest-angle width transfer vs R3 stroke-role and boundary loss conditioning vs unchanged skeleton-only baseline; freeze test characters before generation.
next_real_work.technical_prerequisites: Complete executable generation code + licensed style samples + pretrained or trainable weights + available noncharged local GPU or explicit compute authority; cannot rely on InkDiffuser repo as-is.
next_real_work.stop_rule: If no coherent authorised data or runnable model, keep blocked and do not repeat geometry-only glyph variant loops or claim success.
next_real_work.explicit_user_quality_gate: Human blind rating of legibility and superior artistic quality on unseen text; relative numeric morphology alone insufficient.
